lighthouse_exclusions.scope: every route that is not a family representative
lighthouse_exclusions.reason: Lighthouse is a lab measurement of a template, not of a URL. One representative per commercial family keeps the signal and keeps the gates job inside timeout-minutes: 45. The full per-route geometry proof stays with npm run audit:layout-sitewide and per-route semantics stay with npm run audit:axe.
